name: Teacher in Training
source:
A young teacher in training starts his first internship at an all-girls elementary school, but what happens there is not what he had expected...

[From [url=http://thenecromancer.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-32.html]The Matriarchy[/url]]
translation:
一位年轻的实习教师在一所女子小学开始了他的第一次实习，但那里发生的事情却出乎他的意料……

[来自[url=http://thenecromancer.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-32.html]母系社会[/url]]
